parameters.name: DataLimitId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the data asset such as an instance, database, or bucket. You can call [DescribeDataLimits](~~DescribeDataLimits~~) to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: IntervalDay
parameters.description: The interval in days between two consecutive custom scan tasks. Valid values: 1 to 2147483648.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: OssScanPath
parameters.description: The scan scope for OSS assets. Prefix match, suffix match, and regular expression match are supported.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type of the product to query. Valid values:
- **1**: MaxCompute.
- **2**: OSS.
- **3**: ADS.
- **4**: OTS.
- **5**: RDS.
- **6**: SELF_DB.

parameters.name: RunHour
parameters.description: The runtime of the next scan task. Unit: hours.

parameters.name: RunMinute
parameters.description: The runtime of the next scan task. Unit: minutes.

parameters.name: ScanRange
parameters.description:
The scan scope matching rule for the custom scan task. This parameter takes effect only when used together with **ScanRangeContent**. Valid values:
- **0**: full match.
- **1**: prefix match.
- **2**: suffix match.
- **3**: regular expression match.

parameters.name: ScanRangeContent
parameters.description:
The content to match within the scan scope of structured data assets by using prefix match, suffix match, or regular expression match.

> When ScanRange is set to 0, all content in this field is fully matched. When ScanRange is set to 1, the content in this field is matched by prefix. For example, if this field is set to test/abc, file paths that start with test/abc are matched. When ScanRange is set to 2, the content in this field is matched by suffix. When ScanRange is set to 3, the content in this field is matched by regular expression.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description: The name of the scan task.

parameters.name: TaskUserName
parameters.description: The account that creates the scan task.
